name: opentexila-backend
description: OpenTexila classroom management API — initial JavaScript scaffold.

scripts.db:migrate: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:run -d dist/database/data-source.js
scripts.db:status: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:show -d dist/database/data-source.js
scripts.db:revert: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:revert -d dist/database/data-source.js
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/database.unit.test.js test/examples.test.js test/stack.test.js test/attendance.test.js test/dev-auth.test.js

npm run build && node --test test/database.unit.test.js test/examples.test.js test/stack.test.js test/common.test.js test/attendance-availability.test.js test/dev-caller.test.js test/attendance-class-sessions.test.js test/attendance-records.test.js
